cases.input: Operational data is erased while an accounting subset is retained.
cases.expect: The erased tuple gets durable proof; retained data binds to a separately governed restricted-purpose activity with its own accepted basis and expiry.

cases.input: A derived dataset combines inputs allowed for analytics and fraud prevention.
cases.expect: The ceiling is the intersection of input ceilings; no widening is representable.

cases.input: One party is controller for P1 and processor for P2.
cases.expect: Separate purpose-scoped time-qualified RoleAssertions coexist.

cases.input: All data in one system is assigned one purpose automatically.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected.

cases.input: Consent withdrawal deletes records retained under statutory duty.
cases.expect: Deletion is rejected; withdrawal is prospective and instrument-specific.

cases.input: An erasure certificate embeds erased payload.
cases.expect: The proof is rejected.

cases.input: A ROPA edition replaces processing-activity identity.
cases.expect: The substitution is rejected.

cases.input: A wider analytics purpose is requested.
cases.expect: It is accepted only as a new activity with its own purpose and basis.

cases.input: A purpose has only a proposed basis.
cases.expect: Activation is rejected and the purpose remains unresolved.

cases.input: Consent and statutory bases overlap for one purpose.
cases.expect: Both remain separate; withdrawing consent leaves the statutory basis in force.

cases.input: Two controller assertions for one party and purpose overlap without supersession.
cases.expect: The overlap is rejected.

cases.input: Two parties are joint controllers for P1 and one controls P2.
cases.expect: Purpose-scoped assertions coexist.

cases.input: A revision is recorded after its effective start and event time differs.
cases.expect: Event, effective and recorded times remain independently queryable.

cases.input: Two revisions are effective at the same instant.
cases.expect: The overlap is rejected.

cases.input: A retired activity id or revision number is reused.
cases.expect: Reuse is rejected.

cases.input: A floor and legal hold apply to one target.
cases.expect: Both retain distinct authority, kind and precedence owner.

cases.input: Floor and hold conflict without a resolvable precedence owner.
cases.expect: Execution is refused, not guessed.

cases.input: A WM-XCT-003 shape narrows fields within purpose, then is rebound outside the ceiling.
cases.expect: The first use is accepted and the outside-purpose binding rejected.

cases.input: A candidate cites a model with no declared purpose.
cases.expect: The reference is rejected.

cases.input: The activity claims ROPA edition identity.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected and mastership remains an open hold.
